# AI Profile Photo Maker
> Generate studio-quality AI headshots from selfies in minutes.

## Overview
AI Profile Photo Maker helps people create professional headshots using AI. Upload 10-20 selfies (front-facing plus slight angles), select a style, and receive high-resolution portraits suitable for LinkedIn, resumes, company bios, and professional profiles. No in-person photo shoot required.

## What We Do
- Turn casual selfies into polished, studio-quality headshots
- Offer a range of professional styles (corporate, casual, creative, industry-specific)
- Deliver high-resolution images ready for web and print
- Provide examples and guidance for best results

## Who It's For
- Job seekers, graduates, and career changers
- Professionals updating LinkedIn or company profiles
- Realtors, lawyers, doctors, consultants, and other client-facing roles
- Creators, founders, and remote teams
- Anyone who wants upgraded dating or social media profile photos

## How It Works (Detailed)
1. **Upload photos**: Provide 10-20 clear selfies with varied angles, good lighting, and neutral backgrounds when possible.
2. **Model training**: The system learns your facial features to personalize outputs.
3. **Choose styles**: Select from professional presets (corporate, casual, creative, industry-specific).
4. **Generate headshots**: The AI produces multiple options with consistent lighting and composition.
5. **Download**: Save high-resolution images for LinkedIn, resumes, and marketing assets.

## Results & Quality
- Studio-quality lighting and composition
- Consistent framing and professional look
- High-resolution images suitable for online profiles and print
- Multiple styles to match personal brand and industry norms

## Pricing
One-time purchase. No subscription. No hidden fees. ~15 min delivery.

- **Starter ($9)**: Up to 10 headshots, ~10 style photos, model training included, basic styles, standard resolution, email support
- **Professional ($19, most popular)**: Up to 30 headshots, ~30 style photos, model training included, all premium styles, HD resolution, priority processing, download all formats
- **Studio ($39)**: Up to 80 headshots, ~80 style photos, model training included, all premium styles, HD+ resolution, priority support, advanced editing, commercial license

Full details: https://aiprofilephotomaker.com/pricing

## FAQ (Highlights)
- **How many photos should I upload?** 10-20 clear selfies with a mix of angles and lighting.
- **What kinds of photos work best?** Front-facing selfies with good light, minimal obstructions, and natural expressions.
- **How long does it take?** Generation time varies by plan and demand; priority options are available.
- **Can I use these for LinkedIn and resumes?** Yes—outputs are designed for professional profiles.
- **Do you offer different styles?** Yes—corporate, casual, creative, and industry-specific looks.
- **What if I don’t like the results?** Try different inputs or styles; contact support for help.
- **Is my data private?** See privacy details and retention information in legal pages.

## Comparisons & Differentiators
- **vs. Traditional photography**: Faster, more affordable, and no scheduling required.
- **vs. Generic photo editors**: Personalized to your facial features with consistent, studio-like results.
- **vs. other AI headshot tools**: Focus on professional, job-ready styling and clear user guidance.
